title: Calibration Reporting Standard (CRS) v0.1
description: A 13-field structured attestation protocol for autonomous AI agent calibration disclosure in regulated financial systems. Proposed by Eric T.C. Chan, TRUON. Patent pending. Reference: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=7511058

agent_did.description: Field 1 — W3C Decentralized Identifier (DID) of the AI agent. Binds this attestation record to a specific, verifiable agent identity. Format: did:<method>:<identifier>.

reporting_period_start.description: Field 2 — Start date of the calibration reporting period (ISO 8601 date).

reporting_period_end.description: Field 3 — End date of the calibration reporting period (ISO 8601 date). Must be after reporting_period_start.

system_scope.description: Field 4 — System scope definition: the financial decision categories the agent is authorised to perform during this reporting period, the deploying institution, and the authorisation chain reference.

decision_categories.description: List of authorised financial decision categories covered by this attestation.

deployer_did.description: W3C DID of the deploying financial institution accountable for this agent.

authorization_chain_reference.description: Hash or URI referencing the authorisation chain document (board resolution, delegation record) that approved this agent's deployment.

calibration_rate.description: Field 5 — Calibration Rate (CR): proportion of the agent's probabilistic predictions falling within plus or minus 5 percentage points of observed outcomes over the reporting period. Compliance threshold: CR >= 0.80. Values below this threshold flag the agent as requiring remediation before attestation issuance.

false_positive_rate.description: Field 6 — False Positive Rate (FPR): proportion of negative cases incorrectly classified as positive over the reporting period.

expected_calibration_error.description: Field 7 — Expected Calibration Error (ECE): probability-weighted mean absolute difference between predicted confidence and observed accuracy across equal-width confidence bins (Guo et al., 2017). Compliance threshold: ECE < 0.05. Mandatory recalibration threshold: ECE > 0.10.

human_review_rate.description: Field 8 — Human Review Rate: proportion of the agent's autonomous decisions reviewed by a qualified human principal during the reporting period. Supports human oversight requirements under EU AI Act Art. 14 and MAS FEAT.

systematic_failure_disclosures.description: Field 9 — Disclosures of any decision categories where CR < 0.80 or ECE > 0.10 occurred during the reporting period. Empty array indicates no systematic failures. Enables targeted remediation and proportionate regulatory response.

decision_category.description: The specific decision category in which the failure occurred.

failure_type.description: Whether CR fell below 0.80, ECE exceeded 0.10, or both.

cr_value.description: Observed CR value during the failure period.

ece_value.description: Observed ECE value during the failure period.

reattestation_event_log.description: Field 10 — Log of all material model updates since the prior attestation that triggered re-attestation. Five trigger conditions apply (standard: 30-day window; emergency: 72-hour window). Empty array if no re-attestation events occurred.

trigger_condition.description: The condition that triggered re-attestation. First four: 30-day standard window. Last: 72-hour emergency window.

update_description.description: Description of the model update or change that triggered re-attestation.

reattestation_completed_date.description: Date on which re-attestation was completed (ISO 8601).

attester_did.description: Field 11 — W3C DID of the accredited third-party auditor issuing this attestation. The attester must hold current accreditation from the applicable regulatory jurisdiction. Separates the deploying institution from the attesting authority.

attestation_date.description: Field 12 — Date on which this attestation record was generated and signed by the attester (ISO 8601 date).

regulatory_jurisdiction.description: Field 13 — Regulatory jurisdiction(s) under which this attestation is issued. Multiple jurisdictions supported for cross-border deployments. Use 'OTHER' with a note for jurisdictions not yet enumerated.

compliance_determination.description: Derived from fields 5 and 7. Not stored in the record — computed at evaluation time by the CRS Measurement Engine.
